description_en: Enables the auto-scaling feature for a service and creates an auto-scaling controller for the service
description_zh: 开通服务自动扩缩容功能，为服务创建自动扩缩控制器
kebab_example: aliyun eas create-service-auto-scaler --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --min 2 --max 8 --scale-strategies metricName=qps threshold=10.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateServiceAutoScaler

parameters.help_en: The region where the service is located
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the service. For more information about how to view the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

fields.help_en: The grace period before scaling in to zero. When the metrics meet the conditions for scaling in to zero, the scale-in to zero is executed after the grace period elapses. Default value: 600
fields.help_zh:
缩容到0之前的等待期。
当指标满足缩容到0的条件时，需要经过等待期的时间，才会执行缩容到0。默认值为600
fields.name: scale_down_grace_period_seconds

fields.help_en: The number of instances created at a time when scaling out from zero. Default value: 1
fields.help_zh: 当从0开始扩容时，一次性创建的实例数。默认值为1
fields.name: scale_up_activation_replicas

fields.help_en: The behavior when scaling in to zero
fields.name: on_zero

fields.help_en: The stabilization window period for scale-in. Default value: 300. Scale-in is executed only when the metrics do not meet the specified conditions over the past period of time
fields.help_zh:
缩容稳定窗口期时间，默认值为300。
只有当过去一段时间内的指标均不满足条件，才会执行缩容
fields.name: stabilization_window_seconds

fields.help_en: The stabilization window period for scale-out. Default value: 0. Scale-out is executed only when the metrics meet the specified conditions over the past period of time
fields.help_zh:
扩容稳定窗口期时间，默认值为0。
只有当过去一段时间内的指标均满足条件，才会执行扩容
fields.name: stabilization_window_seconds

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of instances. The value must be greater than the minimum number of instances
parameters.help_zh: 最大实例数，需要大于Min Replica
parameters.name: max

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances. The value must be greater than 0
parameters.name: min

fields.help_en:
The name of the metric. Valid values:
qps: the queries per second (QPS) threshold per instance
cpu: the CPU utilization threshold
gpu[util]: the GPU utilization threshold
fields.help_zh:
指标名称，取值如下：
qps：单实例qps伸缩阈值。
cpu：cpu利用率阈值。
gpu[util]：gpu利用率阈值
fields.name: metric_name

fields.help_en: The service to which the metric belongs. If this parameter is not specified, the current service is used by default
fields.help_zh: 指标所属服务，不配置默认为当前服务
fields.name: service

fields.help_en:
The threshold that triggers auto-scaling.
If the metric name is set to qps, scale-out is triggered when the average QPS per instance exceeds this value.
If the metric name is set to cpu, scale-out is triggered when the average CPU utilization per instance exceeds this value.
If the metric name is set to gpu[util], scale-out is triggered when the average GPU utilization per instance exceeds this value
fields.help_zh:
触发自动伸缩阈值。
指标名称配置为qps：当单实例的平均qps大于该值时会触发扩容。
指标名称配置为cpu：当单实例的平均cpu使用率大于该值时会触发扩容。
指标名称配置为gpu[util]：当单实例的平均gpu使用率大于该值时会触发扩容
fields.name: threshold

Message.description_en: The message returned in the response
